verdict.rationale: Mastra Knowledge documents pages that nest like folders and link to form a graph, plus scoped permissions. Nothing in the evidence shows user-definable entity types, edge or relation types, or an ontology or schema that can be tailored to a domain. Page nesting and linking are adjacent structural features, not memory-schema customization.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can customize the memory schema — entity types, edge types, or ontology — to match my domain
